title: The Rest Stop Phone
hook: Every payphone on Route 9 has the same sticker: if this phone rings, it's for you. Do not answer.
lines: Every payphone on Route 9 has the same faded sticker.
It says: if this phone rings... it's for you. Do not answer.
My little sister and I were driving all night to our dad's place.
Around three a.m., I pulled over. She stayed asleep in the car.
The lot was empty. Just me, a humming vending machine... and that payphone.
I didn't move. Twelve rings... then silence.
My cell buzzed. The caller ID was the payphone.
I let it ring out. One voicemail. No words. Just breathing.
Then, behind me, my sister's phone lit up inside the car.
I watched her answer it, half asleep. She nodded... and hung up.
I tapped on the glass. Who was that?
She stared right at me. It was you. You said to lock the doors... and not to let you back in.
And behind me, the payphone's receiver swung on its cord... and my own voice whispered, Good. Don't let him in.
